en.html:
William Tell's arrow never reaches the apple.

The paradox of "Tell and apple".

William Tell's arrow never reaches the apple.

The paradox of "Tell and apple".

ja.html:
ウィリアム・テルの矢は決して林檎に届かない。
　　　　The paradox of "Tell and apple".
ja.text:
ウィリアム・テルの矢は決して林檎に届かない。
　　　　The paradox of "Tell and apple".

en.html:
...This paradox had given many philosophers considerable suffering. A close relative of the famous Achilles-and-the-tortoise difficulty.

Tell and the apple.

Tell fires his arrow. Will it reach the apple? No. First it has to reach point A, halfway between bow and apple.

But A also has one condition. First reach B, halfway between A and the bow.

And B? First reach C, halfway between B and the bow...

Every halfway has one more halfway standing in front. Infinite points to pass. The poor arrow can never finish the formalities, so the apple it can never reach.

A theory flatly refusing to agree with what actually happens.

The arrow, of course, could lodge itself in the apple while the philosopher was still explaining why it could not. Arre, that is not an answer. First account for point C. The apple could split in two and fall off the fellow's head; the objection would remain perfectly intact. Reality had performed the trick without showing its working. Very bad academic conduct.

The cleverness of this famous piece of sophistry is in what it ignores. Our world is established through observation.

Suppose someone could observe those infinite intermediate points. Not only the points: every one of the infinite instants when the arrow passes them, that also.

For such an observer, the paradox would be true.

But such an observer does not exist in this world.

Cannot exist. Surely————

ja.html:
……それは多くの哲学者を苦悩させた<ruby>背理<rt>パラドックス</rt></ruby>。
　広く知られるアキレスと亀の背理に近しいもの。

　テルと林檎の背理。
　テルの弓から放たれた矢は林檎まで到達しない――
何故なら矢はまず弓と林檎の中間点Ａに到達する必要
がある。

　Ａ点に到達するため、まずはＡ点と弓の中間点Ｂに
到達しなくてはならない。
　Ｂ点に到達するには、まずＢ点と弓の中間点Ｃまで
到達せねばならない……

　このように、通過すべき中間点は無限に設定される。
　従って、無限の点を通過せねばならない矢は決して
目標まで到達し得ない。

　現実の事象に背く理論。

　この名詭弁の巧妙さは、我々の世界が<ruby>観測<rt>・・</rt></ruby>によって
成立するという点を無視しているところにある。

　<ruby>無限<rt>・・</rt></ruby>の中間点を観測し、矢がその一点一点を通過し
てゆく<ruby>無限<rt>・・</rt></ruby>の瞬間をも観測する者がいるならば、その
者にとって背理は真実となるだろう。
　だがそんな観測者はこの世界に存在しない。

　する筈がないのだ――――
